channel.title: The San Francisco Standard - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The San Francisco Standard (sfstandard.com)

item.title: SF’s most audacious restaurant is spinning off a 12-seat speakeasy
item.description: Bar Orso, a bar-within-a-restaurant at the ever-whimsical Merchant Roots, opens Tuesday.

item.title: Live updates: SFUSD teachers strike, bargaining back on, schools closed Tuesday
item.description: Negotiations between the teachers union and district officials resume at noon. The Standard will have updates throughout the day.

item.title: Interim SFPD chief sticks around to help replacement, while boosting his own pension
item.description: After Derrick Lew became chief, his predecessor Paul Yep said he’d continue to provide guidance. By staying, Yep also gets a fat pension bump.

item.title: Seahawks’ title celebration inside Levi’s Stadium is nightmare fuel for the 49ers
item.description: Cigar smoke filled the air, and liquor drenched the carpet, in the most sacred space for Kyle Shanahan’s team.

item.title: The case for a Super Bowl in San Francisco
item.description: The biggest game in sports came to town, and the city put on one heck of a show. It was a reminder that the 49ers don’t have to stay at Levi’s Stadium forever.

item.title: Lurie, riding high on Super Bowl, meets his kryptonite: Organized labor
item.description: The mayor is facing a barrage of battles with unions, an unfamiliar world of bare-knuckle politics.

item.title: SFUSD teachers strike, Day One: Where have all the children gone?
item.description: With schools closed, the parents of 50,000 students try to figure out where to put them.

item.title: Kawakami: Challenging Seattle, Shanahan’s TV star turn, and more 49ers/Super Bowl thoughts
item.description: Now that the Super Bowl goes through the NFC West, it makes the whole endeavor more personal and tangible for the 49ers.

item.title: 49ers player Keion White shot in the ankle hours after Super Bowl
item.description: The defensive end was shot early Monday morning in San Francisco, say police.

item.title: 49ers’ Keion White shot after dispute involving rapper Lil Baby at SF stripper party
item.description: Keion White was holding a private party inside a Mission District club when he was shot in the leg, a police report says.
